roster.title: Children
roster.description: Child records, families and health information
roster.searchPlaceholder: Search for a child (Latin or Arabic)…
roster.count: {count, plural, =0 {No children} one {# child} other {# children}}
roster.emptyDescription: Add your first child manually, or approve an enrollment application.
roster.noMatchDescription: Try adjusting your search or filters.

form.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP — 10 MB max
form.tagCodeOverride: Assigned automatically. Change it only if you already have badges printed with your own numbering.

addDialog.title: Add a child
addDialog.description: Quickly create a child record. You can fill in the rest afterwards.
addDialog.tagAuto: The badge code and QR are generated automatically when the record is saved.

statusActions.withdrawDescription: The child will move to "Withdrawn" status with today's date as the withdrawal date. Their record and history are kept.
statusActions.reenrollDescription: The child will return to "Enrolled" status and the withdrawal date will be cleared.

guardians.title: Guardians / parents
guardians.empty: No guardian linked to this record
guardians.addDescription: Create a new guardian or link one who is already registered.
guardians.unlinkDescription: The link to this child will be removed. The guardian's own record is kept.

credentials.label: Door badge
credentials.revokeDescription: The printed card and the QR code on the parent's phone stop working immediately. You can issue a new badge afterwards.
credentials.issuedDescription: A PIN and a badge code have been created for {name}.
credentials.pinWarning: Write this PIN down now — it will never be shown in full again. If it is lost, issue a new badge.

portal.label: Parent portal
portal.copyFailed: Could not copy — write the code down.
portal.hint: Give this code to the parent. They enter it after creating their account. Valid 14 days, single use.

errors.invalid: That parent could not be found.
errors.alreadyLinked: That parent already has an account.

photo.childDescription: Shown at the kiosk on check-in and check-out, beside the guardian's photo at pick-up.
photo.guardianDescription: Staff compare it with the adult at the door before handing the child over. Without it there is only the QR code, and a QR code can be photographed.
photo.removeDescription: The kiosk will show no photo until a new one is added.
photo.tooLarge: That image is too large. Choose one under 20 MB.
photo.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this photo.
photo.error: The photo could not be saved. Please try again.

guardianCard.title: Guardian badge
guardianCard.noTagDescription: Issue a badge for this guardian from the child's record first.
guardianCard.notLinked: This guardian is not linked to this child
guardianCard.notLinkedDescription: Check the child's record — this guardian is not listed among their guardians.

pickups.title: Authorized pickup contacts
pickups.description: Other people allowed to collect the child, with ID details.
pickups.addDescription: This person may collect the child on presentation of their ID.
pickups.name: Full name
pickups.deleteDescription: They will no longer be authorized to collect the child.

health.title: Health record
health.editDescription: Enter one item per line for list fields.

allergies.title: Allergies
allergies.deleteDescription: The allergy will be removed from the child's record.

attendance.title: Attendance history

billing.feesEmpty: No fee plan assigned to this child

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyDescription: Add the birth certificate, vaccination record or other paperwork.
documents.deleteDescription: The file will be permanently removed from the record.

consents.title: Consents
consents.description: Permissions given by the parents for this child.

typeHints.photos: Taking and sharing photos of the child
